title: Phase 0 data: logged steps of kernel and learned controllers on a broad set of links
description: The logged step data Phase 0 distills from (docs/methodology.md), copied from the project compact was forked from, so that compact's experiments read it from compact's own releases. Source: release exp-data-net1-broad-30s-73 of Radonux/palaestra, unpacked unchanged under steps/ (its own experiment.json and summary.md included, which describe how it was generated: 30 s episodes on a broad set of links and conditions, three controllers per link, every 6th 10 ms step kept, 20 shards). Each shard holds steps.parquet with the observation, the ground-truth label_* columns and the action at each kept step. summary.md lists the source's parts and the campaign directories copied.
run: mkdir -p "$OUT/steps" && curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors https://api.github.com/repos/Radonux/palaestra/releases/tags/exp-data-net1-broad-30s-73 > /tmp/source.json && jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name | contains(".tar.zst.part-"))] | sort_by(.name) | .[] | "\(.name) \(.size) \(.browser_download_url)"' /tmp/source.json > "$OUT/steps/SOURCE_PARTS" && test -s "$OUT/steps/SOURCE_PARTS" && cut -d' ' -f3 "$OUT/steps/SOURCE_PARTS" | while read -r u; do curl -fsSL --retry 5 "$u"; done | zstd -dcq | tar -x -C "$OUT/steps" && df -h "$OUT" && du -sh "$OUT/steps"
collect: { echo '| source part | bytes |'; echo '|---|---|'; cut -d' ' -f1,2 "$OUT/steps/SOURCE_PARTS" | sed 's/^/| /; s/ / | /2; s/$/ |/'; echo; echo "Shards with a DONE marker: $(find "$OUT/steps" -name DONE | wc -l). steps.parquet files: $(find "$OUT/steps" -name steps.parquet | wc -l). Unpacked size: $(du -sh "$OUT/steps" | cut -f1)."; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
